set-variable.value: #[%dw 2.0 output application/java --- { userId: payload.userId, name: payload.name, email: payload.email, dob: payload.dateOfBirth as Date, sex: payload.biologicalSex, height: payload.heightCm, weight: payload.weightKg, activityBaseline: payload.activityBaseline }]

db:select.doc:name: Check for duplicate userId or email
db:select.db:sql: SELECT user_id FROM users WHERE (user_id = :userId OR email = :email) AND deleted_at IS NULL

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { code: "USER-PROFILE-409", message: "A profile with this userId or email already exists", correlationId: correlationId, timestamp: now() as String {format: "yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ssXXX"}, originLayer: "system" }

logger.doc:name: Profile creation failed
logger.message: #[%dw 2.0 output application/json import buildLog from dwl::log var message ={ userId: vars.user.userId } --- buildLog("INFO","Profile creation failed",message,vars.correlationId, vars.flowName)]

db:insert.doc:name: Insert user
db:insert.db:sql:
INSERT INTO users (user_id, name, email, date_of_birth, biological_sex, height_cm, weight_kg, activity_baseline, daily_caloric_target,created_at, updated_at)
VALUES (:userId, :name, :email, :dateOfBirth, :biologicalSex::biological_sex_enum,:heightCm, :weightKg, :activityBaseline::activity_baseline_enum, :caloricTarget, now(), now())
db:insert.db:input-parameters: #[{ userId: vars.user.userId, name: vars.user.name, email: vars.user.email, dateOfBirth: vars.user.dob, biologicalSex: vars.user.sex, heightCm: vars.user.height, weightKg: vars.user.weight, activityBaseline: vars.user.activityBaseline, caloricTarget: vars.dailyCaloricTarget }]

db:select.doc:name: Select user
db:select.db:sql: SELECT user_id, name, email, date_of_birth, biological_sex, height_cm, weight_kg, activity_baseline, daily_caloric_target,created_at,updated_at FROM users WHERE user_id = :userId

ee:message.ee:set-payload:
%dw 2.0 output application/json ---
payload map (item)->{ userId: item.user_id, name: item.name, email: item.email, dateOfBirth: item.date_of_birth, biologicalSex: item.biological_sex, heightCm: item.height_cm, weightKg: item.weight_kg, activityBaseline: item.activity_baseline, dailyCaloricTarget: item.daily_caloric_target, createdAt: item.created_at, updatedAt: item.updated_at }

logger.message: #[%dw 2.0 output application/json import buildLog from dwl::log var message ={ userId: vars.user.userId } --- buildLog("INFO","Profile created successfully",message,vars.correlationId, vars.flowName)]

db:select.doc:name: Select User
db:select.db:sql: SELECT user_id, name, email, date_of_birth, biological_sex, height_cm, weight_kg, activity_baseline, daily_caloric_target, created_at, updated_at FROM users WHERE user_id = :userId AND deleted_at IS NULL

db:select.doc:name: Select User Goal
db:select.db:sql: SELECT goal_id, user_id, goal_type, goal_direction, target_value, target_unit, is_primary, is_active, set_at, achieved_at FROM user_goals WHERE user_id = :userId

db:select.doc:name: Select Conditions
db:select.db:sql: SELECT condition_id, user_id, condition_type, management_status, diagnosed_at, notes, is_active, created_at, updated_at FROM user_conditions WHERE user_id = :userId

db:select.doc:name: Select Dietary Constraints
db:select.db:sql: SELECT constraint_id, user_id, constraint_type, constraint_value, severity, is_active, created_at FROM dietary_constraints WHERE user_id = :userId

db:select.doc:name: Select User Preference
db:select.db:sql: SELECT preference_id, user_id, insight_frequency, preferred_wearable_metrics, preferred_nutrition_metrics, typical_breakfast_time, typical_lunch_time, typical_dinner_time, typical_sleep_time, target_sleep_duration_hrs, units_system, created_at, updated_at FROM user_preferences WHERE user_id = :userId
